subject: HHS ACF - Child Welfare Technology Solutions and Services - MRAS
description: Market research to identify and assess modular child welfare technology solutions and services for title IV-E agencies across planning, implementation, and maintenance and operations to support A Home for Every Child.

subject: USACE CENWD - Collaborative Partnering - MRAS
description: Develop and implement a comprehensive partnering program that engages stakeholders at all levels of execution. Establish structured frameworks, governance-aligned engagement strategies, and communication protocols to promote collaboration, transparency, accountability, and stakeholder alignment.

subject: OMB EOP - Verification & Validation Process Improvement - MRAS
description: The Office of Federal Procurement Policy (OFPP) is seeking information, innovative approaches, and capabilities from industry for a technical solution to address the Government's Verification & Validation (V&V) for Federal Procurement Data System (SAM.gov) reporting.

subject: DOE - Operation Program Support Services (OPSS) - MRAS
description: This Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) is a decentralized BPA. The purpose of this BPA is to form a united team comprised of personnel from both NNSA and the Contractor, focused on delivering broad services related to, but not all inclusive: administrative, management, acquisition, program analysis, human capital management, and technical support services.

subject: ED - Presidential Scholars Program Support Services - MRAS
description: Technical and logistical support for the annual process of identifying, evaluating, selecting and recognizing 161 U.S. Presidential Scholars from a pool of approximately 6,000 eligible students.

subject: DOE - Cyber Security, Information & Support Services - MRAS
description: The contractor will provide expert advice, assistance, and cost-effective solutions to the Office of Corporate Business Operations, Office of Management to respond rapidly to critical IT and management support issues with results based on current market and technical research, handson experience, and IT best practices.

subject: DOC - NOAA Education Scholarship Support Services - MRAS
description: In support of its several scholarship programs, which involve hundreds of students, NOAA OEd requires financial management, logistical coordination, FAR-compliant travel arrangement, and event planning and execution support services.

subject: Reminder: GSA OCAS - Oracle Primavera P6 Software Licenses - MRAS
description: The purpose of this requirement is to provide the PBGC with remote software maintenance and update support for the Oracle-based licensed software suite "Primavera P6." This Primavera P6 Software updates, maintenance, and support will provide a project and portfolio management solution. Part #L70295

subject: Reminder: Army - ADN-MCN FIBER INSTALL - MRAS
description: RFI - provide materials, personnel, and equipment to install 144-strand single-mode ADN-MCN fiber optic cable from DCO B1645 to Server Farm B462 and all six (6) NEC node sites (B2601, B3436, B4301, B4109, B5962, B710), IOT update/upgrade legacy fiber and provide redundant fiber paths for all comms.

subject: Reminder: TREAS - IRS - Remote Desktop support APP Software licensing - MRAS
description: The purpose of this Statement of Work (SOW) is to define the functional, technical, security, and operational requirements for an enterprise Remote Support Solution capable of supporting the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) enterprise environment. The solution shall provide secure remote administration capabilities for Service Desk personnel while maintaining compliance with all applicable federal, Treasury, and IRS security, accessibility, and infrastructure standards.

subject: Reminder: GSA - CALM Recompete 2 - MRAS
description: The CALM recompete will extend software licensing and Help Desk support for PRISM, Bizagi, AWS, and stackArmor, which support Development, Test, Training, and Production environments; and supports CALM DM&E, which provides staffing and technical capacity for new IDVs or custom solicitations in FY28. This is a follow-on to RFI1823959.

subject: Reminder: HHS - NPDB Customer Service & Program Operations - MRAS
description: The purpose of this requirement is to provide customer service and program operations support for the NPDB program, which will include web content development, general Call Center and email support to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) users on all NPDB-related issues, questions, or concerns, NPDB program operations support.
